reservas.title: Bookings
reservas.intro: Book any free slot at the centre. You see every professional's availability for the services your packages cover. From the booking dialog you can set it to repeat.
reservas.legend: This shows every free slot at the centre you can book with your packages, in each professional's colour. Other people's sessions appear as «Taken»; you can join groups that still have room, and opening one shows who's already in.

own.confirmCancel: Are you sure you want to cancel this booking?
own.tooLate: This booking can no longer be cancelled (it needs at least {hours} h notice). Contact the centre if it's urgent.

waitlist.joinedBody: We'll let you know if a space frees up. If it does, the booking is made automatically and the session comes off your package.
waitlist.leftBody: We won't tell you if a space frees up for this session.
waitlist.onListBody: If someone cancels, the space becomes yours automatically and we'll tell you. No need to keep checking.
waitlist.fullBody: This session has no spaces left. You can join the waiting list: if someone cancels, the space is yours and we'll tell you.

reservationConfirmed.subject: Booking confirmed · VindiBCN
reservationConfirmed.heading: Your booking is confirmed
reservationConfirmed.intro: We've saved your session. Here are the details:
reservationConfirmed.outro: See you soon! If you need to change it, you can do so from your area.

reservationCancelled.subject: Booking cancelled · VindiBCN
reservationCancelled.heading: A booking has been cancelled
reservationCancelled.intro: We're letting you know this session has been cancelled:
reservationCancelled.outro: If this was a mistake, get in touch with the centre or book again whenever you like.

sessionReminder.subject: Reminder: you have a session tomorrow · VindiBCN
sessionReminder.heading: You have a session tomorrow
sessionReminder.intro: Here's a reminder of your next session:
sessionReminder.outro: If you can't make it, cancel as early as you can from your area so someone else can take the slot.

bonoLow.subject: 1 session left on your package · VindiBCN
bonoLow.heading: Your package is running out
bonoLow.intro: You have just 1 session left on your {service} package.
bonoLow.outro: Renew it whenever you like so you don't run out of sessions.

bonoExpiringSoon.subject: Your package expires soon · VindiBCN
bonoExpiringSoon.heading: Your package is about to expire
bonoExpiringSoon.intro: You still have sessions to use and the package expires on {date}. If you want to use them, book them before then.
bonoExpiringSoon.outro: If you can't make it in time, talk to the centre and we'll sort it out.

bonoUnpaidCancelled.subject: Your package has been cancelled · VindiBCN
bonoUnpaidCancelled.heading: We couldn't confirm payment for your package
bonoUnpaidCancelled.intro1: Your package was awaiting payment at the centre and we have no record of it being paid within the deadline, so it has been cancelled.
bonoUnpaidCancelled.intro2: That means the sessions you had booked with it have been cancelled and those slots are free again.
bonoUnpaidCancelled.outro: If you had already paid or you think there's been a mistake, talk to the centre and we'll fix it straight away: you won't have to pay again.

waitlistFulfilled.subject: You have a place! · VindiBCN
waitlistFulfilled.heading: The place you were waiting for is yours
waitlistFulfilled.intro: Someone cancelled and we've confirmed the session for you automatically. It's already in your schedule:
waitlistFulfilled.outro: If you can't make it after all, cancel it as early as you can so someone else can take the slot.

newExercisesAssigned.subject: New exercises assigned · VindiBCN
newExercisesAssigned.heading: You have new exercises!
newExercisesAssigned.intro: Your professional has added new exercises for you. Check them in your area for the instructions and videos.

giftRedeemed.subject: Your gift has been redeemed · VindiBCN
giftRedeemed.heading: Your gift arrived
giftRedeemed.introNamed: {name} has redeemed the gift voucher you bought them.
giftRedeemed.introAnon: Someone has redeemed the gift voucher you bought.
giftRedeemed.outro: Thank you for gifting wellbeing. See you at the centre!

giftGifted.subjectFrom: You have a gift from {buyer} · VindiBCN
giftGifted.heading: You have a gift!
giftGifted.introFrom: {buyer} has gifted you sessions at VindiBCN.
giftGifted.introAnon: Someone has gifted you sessions at VindiBCN.
giftGifted.keep: This is your code. Keep it safe: it's what you'll need to type in to activate it.
giftGifted.outro: Sign in to your client area (or create an account if you don't have one yet), go to Packages and enter the code. The sessions will be added to your account.

community.subject: News from VindiBCN

welcome.subject: Welcome to VindiBCN!
welcome.heading: Welcome to VindiBCN!
welcome.intro: We're really glad to have you with us. From your area you can book sessions, buy packages and check your exercises.
welcome.outro: If you have any questions, reply to this email or talk to the centre. See you soon!
